###### Question

::: question

Summarize the total homeless count across all columns containing "Male" and "Female."

:::

```{r}
# Code Here
```

```{r}
#| document: solutions
#| echo: false


pit |>
  summarize(across(contains(c("Male", "Female")), sum))
```

########

```{r}
pit <-
  pit |>
  pivot_longer(-State, names_to = "Measure", values_to = "Count") |>
  separate(Measure, into = c("Shel_Unshel", "Demographic"), sep = " - ") |>
  separate(Demographic, into = c("Demographic", "Year"), sep = ", ") |>
  filter(Demographic %in% c("Black or African American", 
  "Asian", 
  "American Indian or Alaska Native", 
  "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander", 
  "White", 
  "Multiple Races"))
```


###### Question

::: question

Write a function that finds the state with the highest Unsheltered Homesless population in a given year. Iterate the function over all years in dataset.

:::

```{r}
# Code Here
```

```{r}
#| document: solutions
#| echo: false


identify_most_unhoused_state <- function(year) {
  x <- pit |> 
    filter(Shel_Unshel == "Unsheltered Homeless" & Year == year) |>
    group_by(State) |>
    summarize(Count = sum(Count)) |>
    arrange(desc(Count)) |>
    head(1) |>
    select(State) |>
    pull()
  
  return(x)
}

year <- pit |> select(Year) |> distinct() |> pull()

map_chr(year, identify_most_unhoused_state)
```


###### Question

::: question

Write a function that determines which racial group had the highest unsheltered homeless population each year in each state. Iterate the function over all states. 

:::

```{r}
# Code Here
```

```{r}
#| document: solutions
#| echo: false


determine_racial_group <- function(state_name) {
  x <- pit |> 
    filter(Shel_Unshel == "Unsheltered Homeless" & State == state_name) |>
    group_by(Year) |>
    filter(Count == max(Count)) |>
    select(State, Year, Demographic)
  
  return(x)
}

states <- pit |> select(State) |> distinct() |> pull()

map_df(states, determine_racial_group)
```
